latest.title: AI Natives will be the next species
latest.description: Artificial Intelligence is no longer just another productivity tool. It is creating a new class of intelligent digital participants that can learn, reason, collaborate, and generate economic value. In this article, I explore why I call them AI Natives, how they will transform the future workforce, and why the next decade will be defined not just by smarter AI, but by humans and AI working together to build an entirely new economy.

latest.description: Most Generative AI pilots stall for the same reason bad hires happen: nobody tested for the job. A field guide to evaluating models and agents, from benchmarks to production, told through a hiring process everyone has lived through.

latest.title: Build a Custom Action Connector in Amazon Quick using the OpenAPI specification
latest.description: Learn how to build a custom action connector in Amazon Quick by importing an OpenAPI specification. This guide walks through how Quick turns a spec into callable actions, the end-to-end setup workflow, and how the OpenAPI security scheme (oauth2, apiKey, http/bearer) controls authentication. Includes a complete example spec, the exact fields each auth type asks for, and some common pitfalls.

latest.title: Watching Claude Code Work: Streaming Agent Telemetry to CloudWatch and Rebuilding the Conversation
latest.description: When Claude Code runs in GitHub Actions, the agent works where you can't see it. Here's how to stream its OpenTelemetry logs and metrics to CloudWatch with a bearer token — no collector — and rebuild a readable conversation transcript from the raw events.

latest.title: Wi-Fi público: a conveniência que pode custar caro
latest.description: Conectar-se à rede do café, do aeroporto ou do shopping é prático, mas você sabe o que está permitindo com esse clique? Redes públicas são um prato cheio para criminosos digitais. Neste artigo, você vai entender os riscos reais por trás da conveniência, como funcionam os ataques em redes abertas e quais medidas simples podem proteger seus dados sem abrir mão da conectividade.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: NeuroVoice
trending.description: Small moments, repeated daily, reveal what single snapshots never can - patterns that quietly signal neurological risk. NeuroVoice is a multimodal Parkinson’s screening platform that tracks pattern over time to detect subtle neurological changes early.
